title: SMS Marketing Pricing | Text Marketing Plans | SimpleTexting

facts.fact: SimpleTexting's page promotes a Black Friday and Cyber Monday offer giving new customers 30% off their first month with code FLASH30 at checkout.
facts.quote: New customers get 30% off their first month with code FLASH30 at checkout.

facts.fact: SimpleTexting's pricing page states that yearly billing saves 20% compared with monthly billing.
On SimpleTexting's pricing page, the monthly plan's estimated monthly cost is $39.00 per month.
On SimpleTexting's pricing page, the $39.00 monthly estimate is billed yearly at $398.40.
SimpleTexting's pricing page lists a one-time carrier registration fee of $4 on top of the monthly cost.
SimpleTexting's pricing page lists 500 credits at $29 in its cost breakdown for the monthly plan.
SimpleTexting's pricing page states that extra credits beyond the included amount are billed at 5.5 cents each.
SimpleTexting's pricing page lists a local number with same-day activation at $10 in its cost breakdown.
SimpleTexting's pricing page states that additional carrier fees apply beyond the listed plan costs.
SimpleTexting's pricing page states that all prices are in US dollars.
SimpleTexting's pricing page states that its plans have no contracts and can be upgraded or downgraded as needs change.
facts.quote: Upgrade or downgrade as your needs change. No contracts here.
